分类会在默认文件夹内创建真实文件夹。: Creates a folder inside the default folder.
文件名会同步更新，扩展名保持 .excalidraw。: The file name changes too; the .excalidraw extension is preserved.
文件会移入默认文件夹下所选的分类，原位置将不再保留。: Moves the file into the selected category in the default folder.
操作失败，请重试。: The operation failed. Please try again.
这里的 .excalidraw 文件显示在项目页，子文件夹对应分类。: .excalidraw files in this folder appear in Projects. Subfolders become categories.
恢复草稿会打开成独立画布，保存时由你选择文件位置。: Recovered drafts open as separate canvases. Choose a file location when saving.
新建文件夹，整理你的画布。: Create folders to organize your canvases.
打开或保存过的画布，随时回来继续。: Return to canvases you have opened or saved.
默认文件夹中的画布，按分类整理。: Canvases in your default folder, organized by category.
设置默认文件夹以浏览画布: Choose a default folder to browse canvases
换个名称、分类或文件夹试试。: Try another name, category or folder.
外部打开和保存的文件会保留在历史画布中。: Files opened or saved elsewhere appear in Recent canvases.
新建画布并保存，或打开已有的 .excalidraw 文件。: Create and save a canvas, or open an existing .excalidraw file.
「{title}」将从软件中隐藏，原文件会保留在当前位置。: “{title}” will be hidden from the app. Its file stays in its current location.
以后可通过打开原文件将它重新加入项目页。: Open the original file to add it to Projects again.
「{title}」将移到 macOS 废纸篓，并从项目页移除。: “{title}” will move to the macOS Trash and be removed from Projects.
可从废纸篓恢复；清空废纸篓后将无法恢复。: You can restore it from the Trash until the Trash is emptied.
不再提示此操作: Do not ask again for this action
删除失败，画布仍然保留。: Removal failed. The canvas has been kept.
根据分组、容器和位置推断章节与层级。: Infer sections and hierarchy from groups, containers and positions.
画布正在加载，请稍后保存。: The canvas is loading. Please save again shortly.
此文件已经在另一个标签中打开，请选择其他文件名。: This file is already open in another tab. Choose a different file name.
请输入有效的画布名称，不要包含路径或特殊字符。: Enter a valid canvas name without paths or special characters.
请通过 Excalidraw 桌面应用打开此页面。: Open this page through the Excalidraw desktop app.
画布文件名需要以 .excalidraw 结尾。: Canvas file names must end in .excalidraw.
默认文件夹尚未设置。: No default folder has been set.
已有同名文件: A file with this name already exists
不能移动到默认文件夹之外。: Cannot move outside the default folder.
文件已存在，请使用其他名称。: A file already exists. Choose another name.
显示工具名称和快捷键提示: Show tool names and keyboard shortcuts
沿用最近使用的类型；Control 点击顶部便签工具可直接创建子画布图钉。: Remembers the last type. Control-click the sticky note tool to create a subcanvas pin.
完整的编码器与解码器结构，包含 QKV 详解和子画布笔记。: The complete encoder and decoder architecture, with QKV details and subcanvas notes.
打开示例副本自由编辑，保存时选择自己的位置。: Edit your own copy of an example and choose a location when saving.
文件名会同步更新，文件格式保持不变。: The file name will be updated; its format will stay the same.
演示文稿数据损坏或格式不受支持。: The presentation is damaged or its format is not supported.
管理内置插件，连接你的画布与 AI 工具。: Manage built-in plugins and connect your canvas to AI tools.
插件设置失败，请重试。: Could not update plugin settings. Please try again.
启用后修改端口会重启插件。端口范围：1024–65535。: Changing the port restarts an enabled plugin. Port range: 1024–65535.
启用插件并保持 Guzi 运行，即可通过 MCP 连接当前画布。: Enable the plugin and keep Guzi running to connect to the current canvas through MCP.
Token 允许访问画布，请仅交给你信任的客户端。: The token grants access to your canvas. Share it only with trusted clients.
在启动客户端的终端设置环境变量，再复制对应配置。Claude Code 的项目配: Set the environment variable in the terminal that launches your client, then copy its configuration. Claude Code uses .mcp.json in the project; Codex uses ~/.codex/config.toml.
客户端进程必须继承此环境变量；从 Dock 启动的应用不会继承终端变量。: The client process must inherit this variable. Apps launched from the Dock do not inherit terminal variables.
无法读取插件，请重新打开插件市场。: Could not load plugins. Reopen the Plugin Market.
通过本机 MCP 服务读取、编辑和导出 Guzi 画布。: Read, edit and export Guzi canvases through a local MCP service.
连接 AI 客户端，读取、编辑和导出画布。: Connect AI clients to read, edit and export canvases.
无法读取内置 MCP，请重新打开设置。: Could not load built-in MCP. Reopen settings.
管理本地 JavaScript 插件，扩展你的画布。: Manage local JavaScript plugins to extend your canvas.
插件操作失败，请重试。: Plugin operation failed. Please try again.
插件命令失败，请重试。: Plugin command failed. Please try again.
卸载后将删除此插件的本地文件。: Uninstalling removes this plugin’s local files.
无法读取插件包。: Could not read the plugin package.
插件包不是有效的 JSON。: The plugin package is not valid JSON.
插件已导入，启用后即可运行。: Plugin imported. Enable it to run commands.
导入插件失败，请检查插件包。: Could not import the plugin. Check the package.
导入 .json 插件包，为画布添加命令。新安装的插件默认停用。: Import a .json plugin package to add canvas commands. New plugins are disabled by default.
前往设置 → 内置 MCP 启用服务，再通过 MCP 读取插件开发指南。: Enable the service in Settings → Built-in MCP, then read the plugin development guide through MCP.
MCP 设置失败，请重试。: Could not update MCP settings. Please try again.
启用后修改端口会重启 MCP 服务。端口范围：1024–65535。: Changing the port restarts the enabled MCP service. Port range: 1024–65535.
启用 MCP 并保持 Guzi 运行，即可连接当前画布。: Enable MCP and keep Guzi running to connect to the current canvas.
插件包不能超过 2 MiB。: The plugin package must not exceed 2 MiB.
